newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's metalworkers move strike to November 22.
newsitem.headline: Italy's metalworkers move strike to November 22.

text.p: Italian metalworkers' unions said on Wednesday that an eight-hour stoppage called for November 15 would be moved to November 22.

The FIOM, FIM and UILM unions said in a statement that the move was to prevent a November 15 demonstration in Rome from clashing with an international food conference organised by the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO).
The FAO conference in Rome runs from November 13-17 and diplomatic sources said on Wednesday that Cuban president Fidel Castro was on the speaker list for November 15.
Italy's 1.5 million engineering and metalworkers announced the strike earlier this month as part of their increasingly bitter fight with employers for higher wages.
Unions staged a similar eight-hour stoppage last month.
